title: Prior heterogeneous-sensor tactile representation work cited in §2.2 of item 1: T3, AnyTouch, AnyTouch 2, HTT, Sparsh, Sparsh-skin, Sparsh-X
note: T3 — Zhao, Ma, Wang, Adelson. "Transferable Tactile Transformers for Representation Learning Across Diverse Sensors and Tasks." CoRL 2025 (per-sensor encoders + shared Transformer backbone). AnyTouch — Feng, Hu, Xia, Gao, Shen, Sun, Fang, Hu. "Learning Unified Static-Dynamic Representation across Multiple Visuo-tactile Sensors." ICLR 2025 (masked modeling + multimodal alignment + cross-sensor matching). AnyTouch 2 — Feng, Zhou, Mei, Zhou, Wang, Cui, Fang, Yao, Hu. "AnyTouch 2: General Optical Tactile Representation Learning For Dynamic Tactile Perception." ICLR 2026. HTT (Heterogeneous Tactile Transformer) — Bi, Wang, Reddy, Lin, Khajikhanov, Gao, Soh. CoRL 2026 (modality-specific reconstruction + representation alignment between paired sensors). Sparsh — Higuera, Sharma, Bodduluri, Fan, Kaess, Boots, Lambeta, Wu, Mukadam. "Sparsh: Self-supervised touch representations for vision-based tactile sensing." CoRL 2025 (reconstruction, self-distillation, joint-embedding prediction for optical sensing). Sparsh-skin — Sharma, Higuera, Bodduluri, Liu, Fan, Hellebrekers, Lambeta, Boots, Kaess, Wu, Hogan, Mukadam. "Self-supervised perception for tactile skin covered dexterous hands." CoRL 2025 (contextual representations from magnetic tactile histories and sensor geometry). Sparsh-X — Higuera, Sharma, Fan, Bodduluri, Boots, Kaess, Lambeta, Wu, Liu, Hogan, Mukadam. "Tactile Beyond Pixels: Multisensory Touch Representations for Robot Manipulation." CoRL 2025 (integrates image, audio, motion, pressure from Digit 360). This article went only as far as the scope description item 1 gives each and did not read the seven originals separately.

title: I-JEPA and V-JEPA — the joint-embedding predictive architecture lineage item 1 names for Tactile-JEPA
note: I-JEPA — Assran, Duval, Misra, Bojanowski, Vincent, Rabbat, LeCun, Ballas. "Self-Supervised Learning From Images With a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture." CVPR 2023. V-JEPA — Bardes, Garrido, Ponce, Chen, Rabbat, LeCun, Assran, Ballas. "Revisiting feature prediction for learning visual representations from video." Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2024; arXiv:2404.08471. The architecture itself is not explained in this article.
